title: The gut microbiome in graft-versus-host disease: mechanisms of immune modulation and therapeutic approaches
citation_style: numeric [n]; ref_string holds the printed numbers, resolved to Author Year at the end-of-paper step

items.quote: loss of apparently beneficial, often anaerobic commensal bacteria associated with favorable GvHD outcomes

items.note: Functional group (obligate anaerobes). Association only, no mechanism stated. Same canonical claim as MOS_015; dedupe at synthesis. Borderline: 'often anaerobic commensal bacteria' is close to a dysbiosis statement; flag for review.

items.quote: and induce intestinal Tregs

items.quote: correlated with lower enterococcal positivity, higher urinary 3-indoxyl sulfate associated with commensal bacteria, and lower 1-year transplant related mortality
items.note: Rifaximin (antibiotic) decontamination; outcomes are enterococcal positivity, indoxyl sulfate and transplant-related mortality, none of which is a GvHD outcome.

items.quote: a trend towards reduced Enterococcus translocation

items.quote: decreased the duration of oral mucositis and reduced grade II-IV GvHD incidence
items.note: Resistant starch + prebiotic mixture reduces grade II-IV GvHD, but the target is a dietary substrate, not a microbial taxon (effect attributed to diversity/butyrate, no taxon named).

items.quote: but numerically increased GvHD risk
items.note: FMT prophylaxis (whole-community intervention); GvHD outcome stated but no specific taxon as target.

items.quote: the restoration of colonization resistance by diversifying the anaerobic community and preventing domination by pathogenic taxa, which is a major predictor of bloodstream infection
items.note: Anaerobe-driven colonization resistance (3b), but the stated outcome is bloodstream infection, not GvHD; uncited. Promote if read as a GvHD-barrier claim.

items.quote: designed to restore gut microbiota diversity, strengthen epithelial barrier integrity, and reduce bacterial bloodstream infections and GvHD in allo-HSCT patients
items.note: SER-155 defined consortium (16 Firmicutes strains). GvHD reduction is stated design intent; the phase 1b outcome demonstrated was bloodstream-infection reduction, not GvHD. Promote if intent counts.
